AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE
23A-114
STEP 20. Replace the underdrive clutch retainer.
(1) Replace the underdrive clutch retainer. Refer to GROUP 
23B, Underdrive Clutch and Input Shaft P.23B-54.
(2) Carry out a test drive.
(3) Read in the diagnostic trouble code.
Q: Is the A/T diagnostic trouble code number "22" output?
YES : The A/T diagnostic trouble code may have set due to 
external radio frequency (RFI), possibility caused by 
cellular phone activity, after market components 
installed on the vehicle, etc.
NO : The inspection is complete.
